confidence_notes: May 2026 Hiroshima cost-of-living data supports the meal, beer, and coffee anchors, though its sample is modest. Cocktail and wine estimates use their relationship to local beer prices; accommodation anchors are holistic estimates based on the supplied comparables.
comparable_city_reasoning: Hiroshima is a regional visitor hub, but I place its accommodation near the lower-priced examples: basic rooms around Nara and three-star rooms below Tokyo, Kyoto, and Yokohama. Hostel prices are close to the supplied Nara and Tokyo examples.
